scope: First 13 Lane A positions 007-019, actual current bytes after repair

decisions.finding: The bare-token defect is partly repaired because current ClaimText now includes a surrounding clause fragment. However, Explanation still mechanically repeats its second sentence in Note, and occurrence notes uniformly claim that an 'expanded exact clause binds' a marked turn without retaining the grammatical turn evidence. Generic unnamed-compiler ActorAttribution still says only that all six rungs were checked, while named cases generally have no structured ActorAttribution at all. The exact utterer/narrator/quoted-origin ruling therefore remains unprovable from current bytes.
